subject: 🎯 Stock Finder: Sun Aug 30 shortlist | thin day — 2 candidates (GAP, ESTC), both need Monday confirmation
html_body:
🎯 Stock Finder — Momentum Shortlist

Sunday, August 30, 2026 — Kuwait time (reflects Friday Aug 28 NYSE close)

Thin day — 2 of 16 verified candidates cleared the gates

GAP and ESTC, both on real earnings beats. Neither is a clean buy-at-market — both need Monday confirmation.

Friday was a broad risk-off session (hawkish Fed Chair Warsh Jackson Hole remarks) — most bullish web-search narratives from this week got directly contradicted by live IBKR prices.

⚠️ Why the list is short today

16 candidates went into Gate 1 IBKR price confirmation. 14 failed — the live quote either contradicted the bullish search narrative outright (down and off highs while the article said "soaring") or showed too weak a move to count as real momentum. Full breakdown at the bottom. Per the honesty rule, that's exactly what gets reported rather than padded.

Cap-size balance

Every small-cap name the scan surfaced this week (NVTS, SOPH, MNSO, CCEC, BMNR) got crushed in Friday's selloff and failed Gate 1 on live IBKR data. Today's survivors are both mid/large cap by necessity, not by search bias — the small-cap side of the scan genuinely produced nothing that held up.

Momentum Shortlist

~25 raw tickers surfaced across 25 web searches + IBKR topic discovery. 16 verified against live IBKR data. 2 cleared all 4 gates. Run stock-analyzer on either for the full deep dive.
#1 — ESTC Elastic NV
⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4/5) SOFTWARE MID/LARGE CAP 		$99.56 +18.89%

Signal: Q2 earnings beat gapped shares from $83.74 to an opening print of $107.89 (+28.9%) — then a violent intraday selloff to $96.82 before buyers stepped back in, closing at $99.56. Same trading day.

Price: $99.56 (IBKR live, Friday close)  |  Avg daily $ vol: ~$220M (IBKR)  |  RS vs SPY: outperforming — up double digits on a broad down day

Why it's interesting: This is the only one of the two survivors where buyers actively defended a level intraday rather than the stock closing at its lows — the bounce off $96.82 into the close is real evidence of demand, not just a headline earnings number. Day range was enormous (~11% of the stock's value), so the setup is genuine but volatile.

Realistic near-term target: +6-11% over 3-5 trading days if $96.82 holds on a retest — partial gap-fill resistance near $103, then Friday's $108 high.

Entry read: WAIT FOR PULLBACK to $97.00-97.50 (retest of the defended low). Don't chase the current $99.56 — it's mid-range of a huge one-day swing.

Order plan (GTC, all three legs together):
BUY limit $97.50
Stop-limit trigger $96.50 / limit $96.20 (below the defended Friday low $96.82 — a break here means the "buyers defended it" thesis failed)
TP1 sell limit $103.00 · TP2 $107.50
Size: ~0.82 shares ≈ $80 (~15% of $535.68 net liq) · R:R ≈ 4.2:1 to TP1
Event: behind it ✅ Halal: ✅ Verified Defense: ✅ Clear

Halal: enterprise search/observability software (Elasticsearch) — core business permissible. Sizing: fractional shares required (0.82) — confirm enabled before entering. Next step: analyze ESTC
#2 — GAP Gap Inc. (Old Navy, Banana Republic, Athleta)
⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4/5) RETAIL MID CAP 		$23.48 +12.94%

Signal: Q2 adjusted EPS $0.52 beat consensus $0.49; raised full-year EPS guidance to $2.35-2.45 (from $2.30-2.40) and operating margin guidance to 7.4-7.6%. Same trading day.

Price: $23.48 (IBKR live, Friday close)  |  Avg daily $ vol: ~$179M (IBKR)  |  RS vs SPY: outperforming — up double digits on a broad down day

Why it's interesting: Real earnings beat-and-raise, the cleanest setup shape this strategy hunts for. But the intraday tape is a warning sign: opened $25.00, ran to $25.80, then sold off all session to close $23.48 — just 15 cents above the day's $23.33 low, with no bounce into the close. That's weaker closing action than ESTC showed.

Realistic near-term target: +6-9% over 3-5 trading days if $23.33 support holds — next resistance at Friday's $25.80 high.

Entry read: WAIT FOR CONFIRMATION. Friday's close sat right at the session low with no defense shown — don't buy that weak close blind. Needs Monday price action to hold above $23.33 before entering.

Order plan (GTC, all three legs together):
BUY limit $23.60 — only place once Monday's open confirms $23.33 holds
Stop-limit trigger $23.15 / limit $23.00 (below Friday's $23.33 low — no support below that until the pre-earnings $20.79 level)
TP1 sell limit $25.00 · TP2 $25.80
Size: ~3.4 shares ≈ $80 (~15% of $535.68 net liq) · R:R ≈ 2.3:1 to TP1
Event: behind it ✅ Halal: ✅ Verified Defense: ✅ Clear

Halal: apparel retailer — core business permissible, incidental store-card interest is not the core business. Sizing: fractional shares required — confirm enabled. Next step: analyze GAP

🏆 Today's best setup

ESTC — Elastic NV

The biggest confirmed catalyst of the two (Q2 beat sent shares up as much as 29% intraday), and the only survivor where buyers actively defended a level into the close instead of the stock finishing at its lows. That defended bounce off $96.82 is the strongest piece of live evidence in today's whole scan.

Invalidation: a break below $96.82 — the level buyers already defended once. Losing it says the defense failed and the earnings pop is fully undone. That's the stop reference, not a percentage guess.

Cut this run — 14 candidates, with reasons

CRWD — FADED vs live data: search cited a 52-wk high/+27% trailing month, IBKR shows -4.52% today, well off highs.
MRNA — FADED: "skin cancer vaccine soaring 12%" narrative was stale; IBKR shows -4.37% today.
AMD — Stale signal: Aug 25 analyst upgrade to $641 PT is 3+ trading days old; -2.23% today amid a broader chip selloff, no fresh confirming move.
TGT — Too weak: analyst PT raises noted, but only -1.65% today, no real breakout.
NVTS — FADED, badly stale: "+91% YTD" article was from Aug 13; IBKR shows -8.23% today, now ~66% below its 52-wk high.
CRDO — Stale: revenue-growth narrative not dated to this week; -3.01% today, no fresh signal.
DY — Unconfirmed: RSI oversold (26.8) but still falling -4.46% today — no bounce yet, thesis not confirmed.
MNSO — FADED, contradicted: premarket said "moving higher on guidance raise," IBKR shows -3.98% today and price sitting near its 52-week LOW.
SOPH — FADED, contradicted: earnings-beat narrative, but -9.19% today — a steep reversal despite being near 52-wk highs pre-selloff.
CCEC — Illiquid/inconclusive: weekend snapshot showed implausibly thin volume (~1,190 shares) — can't confirm a tradable live signal.
BMNR — FADED + halal-ambiguous: crypto-treasury holding company, -7.37% today; also a speculative digital-asset vehicle rather than an operating business, unclear halal status even before price ruled it out.
CPRI — Too risky/unconfirmed: JPMorgan upgrade produced only a modest +2.88% bounce off levels near its 52-week LOW ($13.56 vs $13.06 low) — a beaten-down reversal bet, not confirmed momentum.
ABT / FOUR — Too weak: PT raises reported, but +0.80% and +0.14% respectively today — no real momentum.
TJX / ILMN / V (Visa) — Faded or too quiet: TJX has given back most of Wednesday's pop ($135.69 now vs $141.69 then); ILMN -4.24% today despite a 52-wk-high mention; Visa is genuinely green on a red day (+0.59%, near 52-wk highs) but too muted to count as a fresh "moving now" breakout. AFRM was hard-excluded before Gate 2 — BNPL/installment lending is interest-based conventional finance, fails the halal screen outright.

How to use this

Neither name is a same-day market buy. Watch Monday's open: ESTC needs a pullback into $97.00-97.50, GAP needs confirmation it holds above $23.33 before its $23.60 limit makes sense. Run analyze ESTC or analyze GAP for the full deep dive before sizing in.

Research output, not financial advice. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Verify halal compliance quarterly on Zoya or Musaffa. Generated Sunday, August 30, 2026 — Kuwait time. Reflects Friday, August 28, 2026 NYSE close (markets closed over the weekend).
